author: Yffe
content: Scaffold via ACToR loop: doc-author (.design/scaffold/workspace.md = crate topology + dep direction + MSRV/edition + CI gauntlet) -> builder (workspace Cargo.toml, per-crate Cargo.toml + minimal lib.rs/main.rs, rust-toolchain, CI; add lib.rs/main.rs routes to spec-routes.toml; empty workspace must pass cargo build/test/clippy -D warnings/fmt) -> critic (audit vs doc + goal.md) -> fixer/builder. doc-author step is forced by the spec-discipline gate (lib.rs is a gated path needing a design doc).
